backend/main.mo: Empty Motoko actor with no backend logic.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping Valentine-related frontend features to their source files and components.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Text file containing prewritten summaries of main frontend files.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind base and theme variables defining a neutral OKLCH color system for light and dark modes.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point mounting the React app and loading main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React component displaying ValentineProposal and a footer with attribution.
frontend/src/components/valentine/Valent: Interactive Valentine proposal UI with evasive No button and Yes acceptance state showing a meme and messages.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: React hook that creates and manages a backend actor tied to Internet Identity authentication.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Context and hooks managing Internet Identity authentication, login state, and identity persistence.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind base with romantic pink-and-white theme variables plus custom heart animations and gradient text.
frontend/src/main.tsx: React entry file setting up QueryClient, InternetIdentityProvider, and rendering the App component.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS config enabling dark mode, custom colors, animations, and plugins. Extends theme with typography, container queries, animations, and design tokens.
project_state.json: Project state describing a Valentine proposal web page with evasive 'No' button, meme reveal on 'Yes', and required assets. Includes feature definitions, architecture notes, and pending requests.
